answer: Because each mesa escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the thread ledger records every share and the pearl audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 2 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 81 aliases means 81 times 2 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 39 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
